    Maths & Sciences

    Covers Mathematics, Science and related STEM areas preparing student teachers to effectively teach at the primary school level. Focuses on inquiry-based learning, practical skills and problem-solving pedagogy.

    View All Departments Contact Department
    Department of Maths & Sciences

    Department Overview

    The Department of Mathematics and Sciences is dedicated to producing competent primary school teachers with strong foundations in mathematical and scientific thinking. The department emphasises hands-on learning, inquiry-based approaches, and the integration of technology in STEM education.

    👤

    [To be updated]

    Head of Department — Maths & Sciences

    Mathematics PSB

    Professional Studies Syllabus B covering pedagogy, methodology, and content knowledge for teaching mathematics at primary level.

    Mathematics Main Subject

    In-depth mathematical content for student teachers specialising in mathematics, including algebra, geometry, statistics, and calculus foundations.

    Science PSB

    Professional Studies Syllabus B for science education covering biology, chemistry, physics, and integrated science pedagogy.

    Science Main Subject

    Advanced science content specialisation for primary teachers focusing on scientific inquiry, experimentation, and curriculum delivery.

    Environmental Science

    Interdisciplinary approach to environmental education, sustainability, climate change, and local ecological systems.

    STEM Education Excellence

    Our department is committed to developing 21st-century STEM educators who can inspire the next generation of Zimbabwean scientists, engineers, and innovators.
